modern_surface.limitation: 2018/2019 acquisition is about 13 years after 2005 reclamation, so settlement, erosion, maintenance, or other surface evolution may be mixed into a pre/post difference. Treat as backup current/final surface, not as the ideal 2005 as-built surface.

evidence: The official 3X CQA/as-built report states that subgrade grading used CAES complemented by conventional GPS surveys.
The same report states that final cover grade was confirmed using CAES and post-cover GPS surveys.
original_engineering_surfaces.historical_recovery_note: The July electronic-file recovery inspected PDF annotations, embedded attachments, filenames, same-domain links, and common CAD/GIS/archive extensions; public Attachment I materials were placeholders rather than the actual survey deliverables.

public_preconstruction_surface.tetra_tech_2004_cover_design_report: referenced in official CQA bibliography but not recovered as an electronic pre-cover terrain surface
